# OpenShell

> Preview of Docker driver from pimlock/openshell-driver-docker (PR #1, 04e5c7c). Only this docset is built here; the rest is at https://pimlock.github.io/openshell-docs/llms.txt.

- [Docker Driver](/openshell-driver-docker/pr-1/drivers/docker/dev/setup.md): Run OpenShell sandboxes as containers on a Docker daemon.
- [Troubleshooting](/openshell-driver-docker/pr-1/drivers/docker/dev/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose common Docker driver problems.
